risks.note: Availability of technical and managerial resources, gap funding needs, and consortium partners' roles and responsibilities.
Achievability of guaranteed parameters, time schedule, and warranty/defect liability obligations on projects.
Coordination with multiple agencies for approvals and clearances required to execute projects.
Unfavorable weather conditions, earthquakes, floods and similar events affecting project sites.
The infrastructure industry is intensely competitive, requiring the Company to leverage expertise and experience to sustain market share, brand equity and service offerings.
Safety of employees and workers is identified as a focus area, requiring ongoing training programs at project sites.

The business is exposed to fluctuations in foreign exchange rates and commodity prices, and has exposures to foreign-currency-denominated financial assets and liabilities; commodity risk is managed contractually via price variation clauses and residual FX/commodity risk via treasury products.
